metadata.description: social-flow marketplace — installs the channel-based short-form and long-form content pipeline plugin (built-in MCP server included).

plugins.name: social-flow
plugins.description: Channel-based short-form and long-form content pipeline — authors an image-included storyboard under data/[channel]/episodes/[topic]/storyboard and takes it through six one-round adversarial reviews before approval, builds the 9:16 or 16:9 video plus per-platform text (Threads·Instagram·Facebook·YouTube) into output/, and publishes after HITL approval. Platform credentials are optional: with them the growth skills run the channel autonomously, without them the pipeline still delivers the finished video to upload by hand. Built-in MCP server (54 tools, no external MCP dependency): SNS publishing and insights, SerpApi/Naver search, data.go.kr collection, and image/video/voice/music generation with on-device engines that need no API key.
